advisories.text:
> **Canary ring notice.** This text is inserted when the canary ring serves this playbook; it is not part of the shared payload. Canary is a pre-release ring. Its installer installs into the same `~/.brainstem` as the stable release, so on a machine that already has a Brainstem, do not run the canary installer over it. Test canary in the isolated flight sandbox instead:
>
> ```bash
> curl -fsSL https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-train/flight.sh | bash -s -- canary
> ```
>
> That lives under `~/.rapp-flight/canary` with its own port (7075), HOME, memory, and sign-in; nothing in `~/.brainstem` is touched. Report findings on kody-w/rapp-canary.
